assets.alt_text: Beekeeper using a blower to clear bees from a honey super during harvest
assets.caption: Bee removal from a honey super during harvest. The photograph documents blower/field handling context, not the complete hygienic transport system.
assets.technical_boundary: Acquisition raster is 449×599 px, about 38.0×50.7 mm at 300 ppi. No upscaling.
assets.hygiene_boundary: After bee clearance, supers must be protected promptly with clean food-safe top and bottom covers, kept off dirty ground and protected during transport.
assets.acquisition_note: Rights/provenance master is Wikimedia Commons. The raster was acquired reproducibly from a documented mirror because Wikimedia repeatedly returned HTTP 429 to GitHub Actions.
